ety.text: The origin is disputed. One theory, a legend, claims it to be from inherited from Sanskrit लवपुर (lavapura) (लव (lava, “Lava”) + पुर (pura, “fortress; city”), literally “city of Lava”). By surface analysis लव (lav) + -और (-aur). Compare Bengali লাহোর (lahōr), Gujarati લાહોર (lāhor), Kannada ಲಾಹೋರ್ (lāhōr), Kashmiri لوہوٗر (lōhūr), Marathi लाहोर (lāhor), Punjabi ਲਹੌਰ / لَہَور (lahaur), Thai ลพบุรี (lóp-bù-rii, “Lopburi”, city in Thailand), Urdu لَاہَور (lāhaur). More at Etymology of Lahore.
